```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The administration has been timid in protecting America's national interests in cyberspace.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans have recently glimpsed the full vulnerability of their information systems to penetration and massive disruption by amateurs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A sophisticated terrorist or adversary government could potentially cripple a critical U.S. infrastructure, such as the electrical grid or a military logistics system, in time of crisis.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A new Republican government will work closely with international partners and the private sector to conceive and implement a viable strategy for reducing America's vulnerability to the spectrum of cyber threats, from the adolescent hacker launching a contagious computer virus to the most advanced threat of strategic information warfare.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans have a strategy that recalls traditional truths about power and ideals and applies them to networked marketplaces, modern diplomacy and the high-tech battlefield.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A Republican administration will use power wisely, set priorities, craft needed institutions of openness and freedom, and invest in the future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president and a Republican Congress can achieve the unity of national governance that has so long been absent.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans envision a confident America united in the fellowship of freedom with friends and allies throughout the world.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans envision the restoration of a respected American leadership firmly grounded in a distinctly American internationalism.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
